spec.title: Texture-rich wall
spec.input: the camera on a surface with structure; frames the worker classified TEXTURE_RICH
spec.expected: features are found in useful numbers, and they sit on real image structure
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 texture-rich frames; median count >= 200 and no frame above 1200; over >= 10 sampled frames the median probability that a detected position out-textures a seeded-random one in the same frame is >= 0.75, against a chance value of 0.5
spec.failureCondition: counts inside the band but a contrast statistic at chance — a detector producing coordinates rather than finding corners

testResults.observed: 79 textured frames, median 353 features (327–554), gradient 8.398; contrast 91% above chance over 275 samples at level 1 (360x640)
testResults.reason: features were found in useful numbers, and they sit where the image has structure — a rank statistic against seeded-random positions in the same frame, which a set of fabricated coordinates could not clear

spec.title: Texture-poor wall
spec.input: the camera on a blank surface; frames the worker classified TEXTURE_POOR
spec.expected: the feature count falls, the engine says so, and nothing is invented
spec.passCriteria: >= 15 texture-poor frames; median count there at most 50% of the textured median and no frame reaching 800; LOW FEATURE COUNT reported where the count fell below 200; the reported state never disagrees with the reported count
spec.failureCondition: the count holding near target on a blank wall — a detector whose output does not depend on the image

testResults.observed: blank: 1046 frames, median 61 features at gradient 2.525; textured: median 353 at 8.398; states {"LOW_FEATURE_COUNT":842,"TRACKING_DEGRADED":701,"FEATURES_OK":951}
testResults.reason: the population collapsed when the structure did, and the engine reported it rather than holding a number up. FEAT-001 shows the points are on structure; this shows they disappear without it

spec.title: Feature grid distribution
spec.input: the 8x6 quota selector, and an ungridded control run on the same frames
spec.expected: the grid demonstrably prevents the clumping §11 asks it to prevent
spec.passCriteria: no cell ever above its quota; over >= 10 paired samples in which the quota actually bound, the gridded selection's largest single-cell share is lower than the ungridded control's in the median case, and it occupies at least as many cells
spec.failureCondition: any cell over quota; a grid that does not measurably reduce clustering against its own control

testResults.observed: 177 binding of 312 paired samples: largest cell share 7.5% gridded against 10.4% ungridded, +0 cells occupied; 0 quota breach(es)
testResults.reason: the 8x6 quota held on every frame and measurably spread the selection against an ungridded control on the same images — a scene that would have been evenly distributed anyway produces no difference and no pass

spec.title: Feature regeneration
spec.input: the population as the scene changes; §11's thresholds at 500, 200 and 80
spec.expected: the population is topped up when it falls, at the levels §11 names, with the state to match
spec.passCriteria: at least one refill triggered below 500 with counts recorded either side; every refill either raised the count or recorded the frame's candidates as exhausted; every threshold crossing that occurred carries the state it produced; the count never exceeded 1200 after a refill
spec.failureCondition: a threshold crossed with no response; a refill that raised nothing where candidates existed; a count above the maximum

testResults.observed: 200 refill(s), 200 of them emergency; 200 found the frame exhausted; 842 frames LOW, 701 DEGRADED
testResults.reason: the ladder ran at §11's levels and every refill either recovered features or recorded that the frame had none left to give — which is a scene with nothing in it, not a mechanism that failed

spec.title: Detection cost
spec.input: the measured cost of each detection, and the one-off level-0 calibration
spec.expected: detection fits §H’s budget, and the level chosen for it is answerable by measurement
spec.passCriteria: mean detection cost <= 8 ms over >= 10 detections
spec.failureCondition: over budget. Advisory because §34 ranks correctness above performance

testResults.observed: 3.553 ms mean at level 1 (360x640) over 2494 detections; level 0 (720x1280) would have cost 27 ms for 221 features
testResults.reason: detection fits its budget at the level chosen, and the calibration says what the alternative would have cost rather than leaving the choice on an estimate

spec.title: Metadata honesty
spec.expected: every field §11 lists is present, and the fields Phase 3 cannot know are null
spec.passCriteria: all eight §11 fields present; forwardBackwardError and reprojectionError null on every record; ids unique and positions inside the frame; cornerStrength and qualityScore finite
spec.failureCondition: any of the above unmet — in particular a zero where a measurement does not exist yet

testResults.observed: 8 records inspected; forwardBackwardError and reprojectionError null throughout, ids unique, positions inside the frame
testResults.reason: the record carries what §11 asks for and nothing it cannot know. The two error terms are null rather than zero, because for an error term zero is the best possible value and claiming it unmeasured would be a fabricated confidence

controller.note: Every decision carries the median worker latency and the budget it was compared against. The controller reads no clock of its own — only the timestamps on the samples it is given (§59).

segmentLog.note: The timeline is cut wherever load injection was switched on or off. FRAME-001 reads the longest unstressed segment; stressed segments are measured and reported but never counted toward continuity.

crossCheckDetail.note: Each pair is one video frame measured twice: on the main thread with an independent 64x48 readback, and in the worker on the pixels the pipeline actually delivered. The readback costs what §H.1 measured, which is why it runs at 1 Hz and is excluded from the pipeline UI cost in FRAME-005.

pipeline.note: Frames declined by rate pacing (pacedOut) are the scheduler working as designed and are not drops. Frames declined because the worker was busy (backpressured) are deliberate too. Only `lost` counts frames that were handed over and never came back, and only that is held against FRAME-001.

features.note: Texture classes are measured from the image, not asserted by the harness: a frame counts as rich or poor by its own mean gradient magnitude, and the histogram above shows where the run actually sat. A refill marked `exhausted` found no further candidates, which is a scene with nothing left in it rather than a mechanism that failed.
